name: UNDO ZOOM
body: The inverse of a ×2 zoom is a ×0.5 zoom: î (2, 0) is undone by î (0.5, 0).

name: UNDO LEAN
body: A shear is undone by the same shear the other way: ĵ (1, 1) → ĵ (−1, 1).

name: SELF-UNDO
body: A mirror undoes itself: flip twice and you are back. Its inverse is itself.

name: UNDO TURN
body: A quarter turn is undone by a quarter turn the other way: î (0, 1) → î (0, −1).

name: NO INVERSE
body: If det = 0 the plane is squashed onto a line: points merge, nothing can undo it.
